cast.characterName: アンナ • ツヴェルフ
cast.originalCharacterName: アンナ • ツヴェルフ

segments.text: Favorite Motto: Learn as long as you live.

A Russian first-year exchange student who came to Japan because she liked anime and manga at first sight. Due to her good looks, she is popular among her male peers— however, her poisonous tongue is known to make them all cry.
Least Favorite Food: Liver and any other internal organs
Favorite Motto: Betrayal is a woman's accessory.
A childhood friend of Keigo. Classmate and friend to Mari, Haruto, Koutaro and Keigo.
Favorite Motto: Love is not seen with the eyes, but with the heart.
A third year, and the classmate of Ninomiya Makoto and Ipponmatsu Yamato. A kind and reliable upperclassman who is always ready to help her peers with a smile.

cast.characterName: 陸・フェルナンド・ハビエル
cast.originalCharacterName: 陸・フェルナンド・ハビエル

segments.text: Hobbies: Driving/Racing, Messing around with mechanisms
Favorite Motto: No rainbow without rain.
His father is Spanish his mother is Japanese.
He grew up in Japan and loves anime.
Favorite Motto: Walls are meant to be crossed.
Second year high school student, member of the kendo club.
At his core he is a serious person, but somehow people think he is a delinquent, but he himself doesn't realize he's known like that.
Least Favorite Animal: Cats (Due to an allergy)
Favorite Motto: I fear boredom more than death.
Favorite Motto: The current situation is restoration-specific and meaningless.
Third year high school student, the student council vice-president.
The heir to the extremely wealthy 'Ninomiya Zaibatsu'.
Hobbies: Getting along with people he has never met before.
Favorite Motto:　Life is more fun when you're stupid.
Third year high school student, the student council president.
Least Favorite Food: Nothing in particular
Favorite Motto: You don't have what you need when you need it.
Second year high school student, member of the basketball club.
The protagonist's homeroom teacher, his subject is Japanese History.
Important Thing: Going to the dentist once a month
Lessons in his early childhood: Piano, Horseback Riding, Ballroom Dancing
Foods he’s weak with: Seafood, things that don’t look beautiful
Favorite Words: Winning may be a little bit dirty, but when you lose its beautiful.

The student council president of St. Louis and also the scion of the Uzuki Company. His self-confidence at home has its capability to seize the hearts of people superior to excellent, has a tendency to be a narcissist. For this reason, more than himself, his popularity stands out tending to have rivals. Many girls make advances to him which leads to trouble often, he himself is not concerned with the problem too much. His charisma is fine even in such trouble.
Family: Four siblings that include three older sisters
Things that he isn’t good with: Things like skinship
Foods that he isn’t good with: Something Sweet
Favorite Words: Half of life is in trouble, while the other half is to overcome it.

The heroine’s classmate. The type has an violent mouth but is the first to take action, the roots of his grades and performance in class are serious also in the top-class. Often acts together with the student council president Yuuto, the two together are labelled KY combi. When something annoying rises, he listens to music pretending not to listen, is also the troubleshooter (solution shop) that cannot leave people who are in trouble.
Favorite Subject: Doesn’t have any. Weak in all subjects.
Things that he isn’t good at: General Exercise
Favorite Words: A perfect lie exceeds even the truth.

A mischievous boy with a cute and delicate atmosphere. However, thanks to his appearance he is forgiven mostly for his carefree smile and personality. Though he loves to make fun of people and play pranks on them, he himself is not good with being made fun of. He blushes when he hears romance stories and quickly shows a shy face.
Foods that he ain’t good with: Tomato (because it’s red), crackers (because it’s hard), Durian (because of it’s smell)
Favorite Words: Before ‘effort’, ‘success’ only comes from the dictionary.

Though his actual age is one year older, he is the heroine’s classmate. Has been easygoing, his obscure words and actions make the surroundings puzzling, just like a sadist he enjoys their reaction. In his private life, there are a lot of mysteries included, such as living in a bad neighborhood with a lot of influence. More than romance, he is interested in other things, that is a dangerous smell that advances to many women, seriously yearns for the daughter type secretly.
Food that he isn’t good with: Natto
Favorite Words: No music, No life!

The heroine’s classmate. His behavior in school is always vigorous and intuitive, his positiveness is strong. Loving surfing because it’s active, he receives high popularity from many females because of his character. Has been a rival of his classmate Kyousuke probably because he is slightly a narcissist. Though he isn’t good at studying, and though his wild music is stupid, his popularity with the senpais and kouhais recommend him to be the next student council president due to his popularity. His nickname is Tattsun.
Foods that he isn’t good with: Spicy things

A morbid person who seems to rise problems. Is sensitive to every sign of trouble that occurs, he imperceptibly disappears before getting involved. Regardless of the flow of before and after of his unique tempo of conversations, it is often said about him ‘I don’t know what you are thinking’. Because he is frail, he has a nutrient intake, he shows an unending commitment in his health, but is it because he’s only health conscious? It is pointed out by many people. Still, being this skinny he thinks he can eat recklessly with the stomach that he has.
Foods that he isn’t good with: Greasy food

The heroine’s homeroom teacher, in charge of the subject math. Unlike anything, he is a flawless universal teacher, naturally he attracts people due to his popularity. On his desk there is always Japanese sweets, he gives it to students who are in a slump. Though he plays sports to an extent, he’s the type that stays fit. In sum, he has deep knowledge in many things, he is the adviser of the tea ceremony club at school.
Foods that he isn’t good with: Spicy things
Favorite Words: The fires of love, in some cases leaves the ashes of friendship behind.

The public health doctor of the school that the heroine attends. His bright and friendly personality makes him popular, he always welcomes the female students but never takes up male students. He is clear with his likes and dislikes and though he has a sharp tongue, he is quite friendly. To please a woman, he goes to such an extent to study topic spots. His change in attitude and look is easy to understand in front of his favorite type of woman. He has a habit of licking his lips, Tsukasa is his kouhai at his university.
Favorite Words: Carrying out original intention!

A classmate of the heroine. Cheerful and active, he takes action immediately due to his curiosity. With his motto ‘carrying out original intention’, single minded he basically has a serious personality, from around him he has a trust that is deep. As soon as he gets along with the heroine, he will show her many things about the school. He has no ulterior motive, he is the type that is genuinely nice to people. Probably because of his nature, regardless of gender he has a lot of friends. His facial expressions seem to change very often.
